items.stem: Based on the texts, both authors would most likely agree with which statement?

Volunteer maps are too unreliable to be useful in any setting.

Musicologist Lorenzo Varesi examined the archives of three eighteenth-century church music schools in northern Italy. Girls throughout eighteenth-century Italy received more rigorous training than historians have assumed.
